srs_contradiction_note: The SRS states the severity scale twice and disagrees with itself. Step 16 (Alert Generation) lists FIVE levels: Informational, Low, Medium, High, Critical. FR lii (Alert Severity Assignment) lists FOUR: Informational, Low, Medium, Critical. Step 16 is the step that actually assigns a severity to each of the ten classes and its examples use High, so the five-level scale is the one that can represent the SRS's own worked examples without loss. The four-level scale is kept here as a selectable alternative so an evaluator who quotes FR lii can be satisfied live by changing `active_scale` -- no code edit, no data migration, because every stored severity is a name and the display order comes from `levels`.

levels.name: Informational
levels.description: Recorded for the event history only. No attention required. Baseline ambient condition.

levels.name: Low
levels.description: Context-dependent event. Worth recording and surfacing in the timeline; not a security or safety response.

levels.name: Medium
levels.description: Warrants attention during the shift. Escalate if it repeats above the configured rate.

levels.name: High
levels.description: Security-relevant event. Must be visible on the dashboard and acknowledged by an authorized user (FR liv, FR lv).

levels.name: Critical
levels.description: Potential threat to life or safety. Must be confirmed across consecutive windows before it is raised (FR xl, FR xlvi) and must reach a human immediately once raised.

mapping_between_scales.note: Applied only when `active_scale` is `four_level_fr_lii`. The mapping deliberately maps High onto Critical rather than onto Medium: the four-level scale has no slot for 'high severity', and FR xlii promises Glass Breaking a 'high-severity security alert', FR xliii the same for Alarm or Siren, FR xlvi a critical alert for Gunshot. Downgrading those to Medium would silently break those three FRs at the moment the scale is switched. `recorded_severity` is never rewritten -- the mapping only decides which name the UI shows and which filter value matches.
